SCORE: successor-shell-angle | behavior_evidence=4 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=4 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=3
SCOPE: successor-shell-angle | IN_SCOPE | Training-only successor entropy and shared-successor pairs shape the same Poincaré-mapped pre-quantization representation used by the quantizer; behavior-off, Euclidean-geometry-off and both-on switches are specified. However, pairwise geodesics over roughly 1,024 batch items at every step are a substantial cost, and the claimed fixed coefficient calibration from initial-batch loss scales is underspecified.
EVIDENCE: successor-shell-angle | 6cdb8f99acb2f13c E1 E2 E5 E6 E12 E13 E14
OBJECTION: successor-shell-angle | The specification’s O(B²D) geodesic computation at every step may not fit the frozen wall-clock budget; moreover, calibrating each auxiliary coefficient from its initial-batch mean is not fully defined for correlation versus contrastive losses.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: successor-shell-angle | For any z with ||z||>0, exp₀ followed by log₀ returns z, so if both radial correlation and pairwise distances are evaluated in the tangent representation under a matched Euclidean metric, this particular map round-trip alone changes no computation; any benefit must come from the curved distances, not the exp/log names.
RATIONALE: successor-shell-angle | behavior_evidence=4 because E5 measures a strong, covered train-only entropy/top-successor-mass relationship, though it does not directly validate the proposed shared-successor sibling signal. geometry_necessity=3: Poincaré geodesic distances can differ from Euclidean distances, but no argument rules out cancellations or establishes added value against a matched control (E12–E14). novelty=3: the combined radial-entropy and sibling-geodesic pathway is distinct as specified, but the bundle documents measured successor-geodesic and entropy mechanisms (E6–E7), so its distance from prior work is not fully established. downstream_mechanism=4: both losses alter the representation quantized into SIDs; expected assignment effects are named, but the proposed SID diagnostic does not itself establish recommendation gains. falsifiability=3: switches and the single-run Recall criterion are present, but matched-control implementation detail is incomplete. implementability=2: the full pairwise cost is a material budget risk and the calibration rule needs a precise definition. exploration_value=3: this combines known signal families in a different pathway. Stage 2 diagnostics are not admission criteria; no Recall prediction is made.

SCORE: branch-geodesic-rank | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=4 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=4 | exploration_value=3
SCOPE: branch-geodesic-rank | IN_SCOPE | Training-only popularity-adjusted successor overlap selects ranked pairs, whose Poincaré distances directly train the pre-quantization representation. Behaviour-off, Euclidean-geometry-off and both-on comparisons are specified; only the both-on run is required.
EVIDENCE: branch-geodesic-rank | 7c263a64f1c3858f E1 E2 E5 E6 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15
OBJECTION: branch-geodesic-rank | The cited measured successor-geodesic mechanisms underperform the reported Euclidean/resampling variants on Recall@10 (E6); the proposal does not establish why its popularity-adjusted rank target avoids the same failure.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: branch-geodesic-rank | If all candidate encoder vectors lie in a sufficiently small neighborhood of the origin, Poincaré distance is locally proportional to Euclidean distance; the ranking can then be the same as the Euclidean control, leaving little geometric distinction.
RATIONALE: branch-geodesic-rank | behavior_evidence=3: E5 supports meaningful successor concentration, but the proposed overlap affinity itself has no measured coverage or predictive statistic in the bundle. geometry_necessity=3: curved distance is explicit and geometry-off is specified, but local geometry can reproduce the ranking (E11–E15). novelty=3: rank supervision is distinct computationally from the cited coarse successor-geodesic results, but a traceable comparison to broader prior art is UNKNOWN; a bounded check is to compare its loss and pair construction against the existing mechanism ledger. downstream_mechanism=4: ranked distances update the same latent input to quantization, with SID and Recall effects hypothesized. falsifiability=3: three switches and a single-run judgment are named, but no explicit mechanism-refutation diagnostic beyond the outcome is defined. implementability=4: sparse preprocessing and O(BD) sampling/distances are specified; fanout and rank-sampler details remain risks. exploration_value=3: a distinct ranking target tests whether relative overlap order helps.

SCORE: mobius-nextstep-drift | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=2 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=1 | exploration_value=2
SCOPE: mobius-nextstep-drift | OUT_OF_SCOPE | It names training-only transitions and Poincaré operations, but does not provide a coherent, dimensionally specified path from the predicted successor displacement to the quantizer input. In particular, r_i=log_{z_i}(q_i)=v_i is a tangent vector at z_i, while the unchanged quantizer expects a consistent latent interface; the later score uses c_k without specifying whether codewords are ball points or tangent vectors. The three switches are named, but the core computation is not sufficiently well-defined to implement as written.
EVIDENCE: mobius-nextstep-drift | f4f827d724b7f292 E1 E2 E5 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15
OBJECTION: mobius-nextstep-drift | The specification mixes encoder tangent vectors, Poincaré points, tangent displacements, and codewords in an assignment score without defining compatible domains or a differentiable assignment/update rule.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: mobius-nextstep-drift | If z_i is a Euclidean tangent vector and c_k is a Euclidean codeword, d_P(exp_{z_i}(v_i),c_k) is undefined: the first argument is intended as a ball point, while c_k has no stated ball mapping. If instead both are mapped via exp₀, that is a different, unspecified score.
RATIONALE: mobius-nextstep-drift | behavior_evidence=3: directed transitions are plausible and measurable in the bundle (E5), but the specific equal-weight successor mean and coverage are not measured. geometry_necessity=2: the stated curved operation is explicit, yet no coherent matched Euclidean assignment counterpart is given and its added value is not argued (E11–E15). novelty=2: it resembles successor-direction/residual mechanisms already measured in E6–E7, with an unclear computational distinction. downstream_mechanism=2: it intends to affect assignments but the score/input interface is ambiguous. falsifiability=3: switches and a single-run criterion are present, although matched controls cannot be faithfully implemented until the domains are resolved. implementability=1: the specification needs redesign to define coordinates, codeword mapping, and assignment gradients. exploration_value=2: successor direction is a small variation of measured residual/geodesic families. A bounded check to resolve UNKNOWN would be a dimension/domain audit of each term and a runnable forward-pass shape test; no Recall prediction is made.

SCORE: incoming-cone-context | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=3 | exploration_value=3
SCOPE: incoming-cone-context | IN_SCOPE | Training-only incoming predecessor distributions and concentration weight a Poincaré context-loss pathway on encoder latents before the baseline tangent-space quantizer; behavior-off, geometry-off and both-on switches are stated. Curved geometry is computationally present, though its necessity over the matched Euclidean counterpart is not established.
EVIDENCE: incoming-cone-context | 3424dd46c9284b24 E1 E2 E5 E6 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15
OBJECTION: incoming-cone-context | The loss attracts a target to a mean of its predecessors’ item representations; the evidence bundle measures successor statistics, not incoming-context concentration or whether predecessor proximity predicts next-item recommendation.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: incoming-cone-context | With one effective predecessor context, the one-step mean is m_b=exp₀(log₀(x_a))=x_a; the loss is simply geodesic attraction of x_b to x_a, a pairwise attraction that a Euclidean squared-distance loss can implement.
RATIONALE: incoming-cone-context | behavior_evidence=3: incoming transitions are a plausible, testable signal, but the measured statistic E5 is outgoing entropy and does not support the proposed incoming-concentration hypothesis. geometry_necessity=2: Poincaré exp/log/distance are explicit, but the single-predecessor case reduces to ordinary attraction and no advantage over a matched Euclidean loss is argued (E11–E15). novelty=3: incoming-context prototypes differ from the measured outgoing entropy/coarse-geodesic mechanisms, but novelty against external cited work is UNKNOWN; a bounded check is a ledger/prior-art comparison of predecessor-context barycenter losses. downstream_mechanism=3: the loss changes quantized target latents, but the recommendation chain and expected direction are plausible rather than strongly diagnosed. falsifiability=3: the three switches are defined and the one-run criterion is clear; a specific refutation diagnostic is not fully specified. implementability=3: equations and sparse preprocessing are implementable, though “at most 24,556 sparse edge lookups” does not fully specify batching/cache behavior or loss scaling. exploration_value=3: it tests incoming-context attraction as a distinct signal.

SCORE: successor_transport_curvature | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=4 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=3
SCOPE: successor_transport_curvature | IN_SCOPE | A training-only, popularity-adjusted directed successor distribution defines a target matched to geodesic-distance logits on the encoder representations consumed by quantization. Behaviour-off and Euclidean-geometry-off comparisons are stated. The candidate-set and representation-cache details are inconsistent enough to leave substantial implementation uncertainty.
EVIDENCE: successor_transport_curvature | a5fbd7bfb00085f8 E1 E2 E5 E6 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15
OBJECTION: successor_transport_curvature | The proposal says candidate representations are cached per epoch while gradients are refreshed only for current minibatch candidates; stale or detached candidate representations would make the stated KL objective differ from the intended end-to-end coupled pathway.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: successor_transport_curvature | If all candidate vectors are identical, every geodesic logit is equal and p_H is uniform regardless of curvature; the KL then supplies no discriminating geometric gradient to separate successors.
RATIONALE: successor_transport_curvature | behavior_evidence=3: E5 supports nonuniform successor behavior, but popularity-corrected q and its coverage are not directly measured. geometry_necessity=3: geodesic logits act in the behavior-conditioned distribution and a Euclidean control is named; the bundle’s geometry sanity test is not evidence that curvature helps the task (E11–E15). novelty=3: matching a full transition distribution via geodesic logits is computationally distinct from radial entropy and coarse successor-geodesic mechanisms in E6–E7, while external prior-art comparison is UNKNOWN; a bounded check is a targeted prior-art/ledger comparison of distribution matching in hyperbolic item spaces. downstream_mechanism=4: transition probabilities shape distances between representations that feed quantization, with a named next-item objective. falsifiability=3: both switches and single-run criterion are specified, but cache freshness and a diagnostic separating representation learning from stale-candidate effects need resolution. implementability=2: “up to 32” truncation, candidate union, and cached-gradient behavior need a precise, consistent implementation; the scale and temperature are measured once but require careful definition. exploration_value=3: this tests distribution matching rather than a single successor centroid. No Recall prediction is made.

SCORE: branch_tangent_parallel_transport | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=3 | exploration_value=3
SCOPE: branch_tangent_parallel_transport | IN_SCOPE | Training-only successor-branch profiles define a target Gram matrix for transported Poincaré tangent directions; this loss updates the pre-quantization encoder representation. Behaviour-off and Euclidean geometry-off switches are specified, and only the both-on run is called for.
EVIDENCE: branch_tangent_parallel_transport | 7ae662a474da0f50 E1 E2 E5 E6 E10 E12 E13 E14
OBJECTION: branch_tangent_parallel_transport | The proposed sign convention for the source-to-successor direction is confusing: log_{x_j}(x_i) is a vector at x_j pointing toward x_i, so transport to x_i and negation need a precise implementation convention to ensure the target direction and Gram similarities are correct.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: branch_tangent_parallel_transport | If a source has exactly two successors and B_i(j,k)=0, matching only their cosine to zero makes the two branch vectors orthogonal; it does not encode which branch is more likely unless the q(j|i)q(k|i) weighting or other terms affect the objective.
RATIONALE: branch_tangent_parallel_transport | behavior_evidence=3: E10 measures branch-degree coverage and entropy, but does not measure the proposed outgoing-profile cosine target. geometry_necessity=3: log maps and parallel transport form an explicit curved operation on directions, but the matched Euclidean alternative is not shown to fail or be cancelled (E12–E14). novelty=3: branch arrangement differs from radial and global sibling objectives, but external prior-art traceability is UNKNOWN; a bounded check is a computational comparison against the existing mechanism ledger and parallel-transport branch objectives. downstream_mechanism=3: the loss changes the pre-quantization encoder gradients, but the link from branch Gram structure to generative decoding is plausible, not directly diagnosed. falsifiability=3: switches, one run, and a possible branch diagnostic are present; a clear quantitative falsifier is missing. implementability=3: the operation and 16-successor cap are specified, but the tangent-vector sign and minibatch pair accounting require clarification. exploration_value=3: it probes a distinct directional branch-structure hypothesis. No Stage 2 diagnostic is used as an admission rule or Recall prediction.

SCORE: successor_transport_code | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=2
SCOPE: successor_transport_code | OUT_OF_SCOPE | The signal and curved operations are named, and switches exist, but the equations regress a source-to-mean displacement against a mean of source-to-successor displacements; when the mean is defined consistently these are the same vector, so the stated loss cancels to zero and provides no real behavior–geometry coupling.
EVIDENCE: successor_transport_code | 98e1bb8f96852453 E1 E2 E5 E6 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15
OBJECTION: successor_transport_code | The two sides of the Huber regression are algebraically the same transported tangent vector when μ_i is the weighted Fréchet mean defined from those same successors; consequently the proposed core loss is identically zero (up to approximation/numerics).
COUNTEREXAMPLE: successor_transport_code | In the Euclidean geometry-off case with one successor j, μ_i=x_j, so log_{x_i}(μ_i)=x_j−x_i and the weighted mean of successor differences is also x_j−x_i; their difference is 0. The same cancellation holds for a single successor in the stated hyperbolic case.
RATIONALE: successor_transport_code | behavior_evidence=3: directed transitions are plausible and E5 establishes successor-distribution variation, but the behavior-to-loss signal is null as written. geometry_necessity=2: Poincaré operations are explicit, yet they cancel from the residual when the same mean is used on both sides (E11–E15). novelty=2: it is a successor-direction regression variation of measured residual/geodesic families (E6–E7), and the cancellation removes its claimed distinction. downstream_mechanism=3: the intended chain to quantized IDs is stated, but the zero objective supplies no such gradient. falsifiability=3: switches and controls are named, and the cancellation is a direct falsifier; the proposal’s own diagnostics should reveal a zero loss/gradient. implementability=2: the operators are implementable, but meaningful behavior coupling requires redesign. exploration_value=2: the cancellation itself is an informative but small variation of an existing family. No Recall prediction is made.
